narrative.weekly_mirror: This week held both inherited practice and your own making: you taught Vihaan verses you learned from Appa, while also developing fourteen indigo shades through a fermentation vat and an old Kalamkari manual. When you shared Priya’s proposal with Ravi, you were met with unexpected support; later, Mummyji’s comment about “opening a factory in the house” left you replaying the dinner and noticing that nobody asked what you wanted.
narrative.tension_explanation: There is no confirmed current pattern to name, though the week contains a real tension. Passing on the Vishnu Sahasranama seems connected to what you were raised with, while the store-room idea touches your wish to choose your own path—and the hurt of not being asked a genuine question remains present in your account.
narrative.reflective_question: When you hold the teaching, the indigo work, and the store-room idea together, what feels chosen by you, and what feels shaped by expectations around you?
